request.subject: PORTRAIT:CULT:MASS

layers.text: Change only one colour: the red and pink inside of every small open mouth becomes dark teal, colour #145f6b, with no red and no pink left. Every mouth keeps its shape and its small cream teeth. Do not redraw anything else: keep the teal heap, the eyes, the tendrils, the shape, the thick black outline and the art style exactly the same, on a transparent background.
